source: OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP (~3m history available via public API here)
hypothesis: When funding is in the bottom 10% of the train-period funding distribution, next-day KRW-BTC return beats same-window baseline
anti_overfit: percentile fixed at 10% before looking at returns
threshold computed on train funding only
holdout is later half by time; no threshold refit
AE7 absolute -0.05% kept as separate failed/untestable id
data_limit: Public OKX/Bitget history depth ~3 months in this environment; absolute -0.05% never observed in-window
